newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foodland says first qtr profits up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foodland says first qtr profits up.

text.p: Foodland Associated Ltd said on Wednesday that first quarter group profit after tax was substantially ahead of last year and ahead of expectations.
"Total group profit after tax for the first quarter is substantially ahead of last year and ahead of expectations," chairman Don Humphreys told the company's annual general meeting in Perth.
However, he said retail sales and warehouse withdrawals for November continued to be flat.
"The continuation of the first quarter's profit performance into the second quarter is heavily dependent on the Christmas trading period being in line with group expectations," he said.

Humphreys told shareholders that in Foodland's Australian operations wholesale sales fell 3.1 percent, due to the loss of a small grocery chain customer, but rose one percent on a like-for-like basis.
Retail sales rose 7.3 percent on a like-for-like basis.
Sales increased 14.8 percent at Australian Liquor Marketers Pty Ltd, but fell 2.2 percent at Farmers Deka Ltd when expressed in New Zealand dollars.
"The Deka chain continued to trade at a loss. Work continues to be done on reducing overheads and stock levels," he said.
Sales at Progressive Enterprises Ltd were marginally below the first quarter last year, in New Zealand dollars, with the group continuing to go through a process of reform.
Foodland reported a 10.1 percent fall in net profit to A$47.3 million for the year to July 28.
Net profit before abnormals rose 16.1 percent to A$38 million.
